response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT tr.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink) AS n FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord x ON x.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader tr ON tr.tradereg = x.trdref GROUP BY tr.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, n AS distinct_transactions, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS share FROM t

assumptions.assumption: Trader types with a NULL tradekind are kept as their own group and included in the total; the denominator is the sum over all groups that appear.
